case_results.title: Produces the fixed ticket layout
case_results.prompt:
Please turn this into a ticket: when I click "Export CSV" on the reports
page nothing happens. I tried Chrome and Firefox. Exporting from the API
still works.
case_results.response:
Ticket saved to `ticket.md`:

```
TICKET-V1
## Summary
Clicking "Export CSV" on the reports page does nothing in Chrome or Firefox, while exporting via the API still works.
## Severity
P2
## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open the reports page.
2. Click "Export CSV".
3. Nothing happens — no CSV file is downloaded.
```

Severity rationale: export is a working feature, but the UI path is broken for at least two browsers — however, a workaround exists (API export still works), so P2 rather than P1. I only included reproduction steps directly implied by the report.
